5960.title: Unknown hook cancellation leaves environment cleanup retrying without progress
5960.rootCauseOneLine: Unknown hook cancellation leaves its durable operation pending; teardown schedules the same failure again after 60 seconds, and cleanup only requests another attempt.

prReviews.verdict: IMPLEMENTATION PENDING: the inspected diff adds regression coverage only; not executed.

5960.proposedFix: Separate unrecognized operations from unverified termination, retain conservative process-safety checks, bound retries, and provide explicit inspection-based recovery through CLI and SDK.
5960.caveats: Source-level reproduction with real migrated SQLite and deterministic host RPC responses, repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout. No affected production host or historical retry counts were inspected. Daemon restart alone does not prove detached hook processes exited. No duplicate fix PR: open PR #5961 links this issue.
